articles.title: Pope appeals for international aid for Ebola victims in DRC - Vatican News
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV urges international care for people affected by the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and for victims of a mining incident in the Central African Republic.
articles.content:
By Devin Watkins
As he prayed the Angelus on Sunday, Pope Leo XIV recalled the ongoing outbreak of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
